text_block_list.text:
I watch over Sakura Laurel's run from 
beyond the turf.

She has incredible power when striking her 
feet down. That allows her to get strong 
propulsion from the ground's rebound 
force, boosting her drive forward, but—
choice_data_list:
(On the other hand, the strain on the legs 
is immense...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhh—!!
(Screeeeeeech...!)

text_block_list.name: Nightmare Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“She's not accelerating! Sakura Laurel! 
Sakura Laurel is slowing down at an 
alarming rate! What happened?! The lead 
remains unchanged—”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Haah... haah... Trainer...-san..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: (N-No way...)

text_block_list.text:
...The sight of Sakura Laurel accelerating 
overlaps with that nightmare.
choice_data_list:
(Our situations should be completely 
different, and yet...)

text_block_list.text:
What if, by some terrible chance, her legs 
give out from just this next single step?
If it were to ever crumble—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —I'm okay.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.text:
Just then, I felt like I could hear Sakura 
Laurel's voice carried on the wind—

In the next moment, my eyes were 
captivated by the sight of her kicking up 
the turf with all her might.
(WHOOOOOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sakura Laurel takes a spectacular 1st 
place in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!! 
Fulfilling Japan's long-cherished dream, 
she shines at the pinnacle!"
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAH...!!)
(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
All our rising stars have completed their 
Make Debut! They put on a brilliant 
display of pure talent!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer-saaan! Were you watching?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
How was my run?! Pretty amazing, wasn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna give in to you, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I won't ask you to 'Please take me to the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I won't ask you to protect me. Nor will I 
ask you to pave the way for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to France together. Let's dream 
together.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Sakura Laurel takes a spectacular 1st 
place in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!! 
Fulfilling Japan's long-cherished dream, 
she shines at the pinnacle!"

In that instant, words came to mind. 
Surely, no, without a doubt. Her running 
is—...
choice_data_list: (Laurel's running—is my dream.)
(Laurel's running—is my dream.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes, Trainer... they're completely 
different from before. They're sparkling 
so brightly.
choice_data_list: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell? It's just so sparkly! It's 
super pretty... Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Trainer, please look into my 
eyes!
choice_data_list: What is going on!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Because I don't have a mirror on me! And 
your eyes look so adorable right now, 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Right! Can't you see it reflected in my 
eyes?"
choice_data_list: Y-You don't need to look!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. But I really like your eyes the way 
they are right now, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Because they're truly sparkling! That 
surely means..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's because you share the same dream as 
me, isn't it? —The dream of winning the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

Sakura Laurel's eyes as she gave that 
gentle smile shone with such breathtaking 
brilliance.
And the day after the debut raceâ

On this day, we were planning to hold a 
meeting and start light training for the 
next race, but...
choice_data_list:
It's past the meeting time, but she isn't 
here...?

text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

The smartphone in my pocket vibrates. The 
sender of the message is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainerrr... I'm so sorryyy...
choice_data_list: What's wrong, Laurel!?
What's wrong, Laurel!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My body felt a little heavy... so I ended 
up skipping classes...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since training looks difficult right 
now... I wanted to apologize in person...
choice_data_list:
You don't need to apologize, just get some 
good rest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... But still... Please, just one 
word...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not feeling well right now, but... 
I'll get better for sure."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: That's why racing is—
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, let's figure things out based 
on how you feel.

It's okay, let's figure it out based on 
how you're feeling

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list:
Let's keep moving forward, step by step, 
for our dreams.

text_block_list.text:
Not being afraid to take a clumsy step 
forward, like back when she feared the 
nightmares.

Give everything I can right now, and look 
forward. —So that one day, I can achieve 
my dream.
choice_data_list:
(If nightmares scare you, just change the 
future)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Those eyes of yours. I really like 
them.

And with the dorm head's permission, I sat 
down with Sakura Laurel in the lobby to 
discuss our future goals for a bit.

I decided to narrow down our immediate 
goal to just one thing: "running in a 
race."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying we'll always decide our 
races based on physical condition.
choice_data_list:
Try to go to the hospital as often as you 
can.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So that one day, in perfect 
condition, I can keep running. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Next year will be my chance at the Derby. 
I want to do something about these legs of 
mine before then.
choice_data_list:
Do you still want to run in the Derby 
after all?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Ever since being born as an 
Umamusume, running in the Japanese Derby 
has been my dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My ultimate goal is the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, though. If it's a stage everyone 
dreams of, then I have the right to dream 
of it too.
choice_data_list:
Then we need to be even more careful about 
your condition.

Then we need to be even more careful about 
your condition.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoa, an adult.
choice_data_list:
If anything feels off, make sure to tell 
me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. Of course.

And so, after parting ways with Sakura 
Laurel, I returned to the Trainer's Office 
alone to finish up some work.

—The dream I had that night was one where 
Sakura Laurel claimed victory in the "Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*... I need to sleep soon... 
Tomorrow I have to... hm?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Who is that? Laurel-san...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...If it goes like it always does, it'll 
be all better by tomorrow. Yeah."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So that someday, I can run at full power 
too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I hope it makes it in time for the 
Classics.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I almost wish it would just heal up 
completely in time for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. But if we're aiming to make it to 
the Derby, we'll need the track record to 
qualify for it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why this goal is more than enough 
for now. To run in whatever races I can, 
get used to racing— ...and build up a 
record for the future.
